summary: Tested all Socratic Engine API endpoints for the hyper-personalized chess coaching application. All 5 endpoints working correctly: /api/coach/socratic/start, /api/coach/socratic/respond, /api/coach/socratic/hint, /api/coach/socratic/reveal, and /api/coach/debug/test-socratic. The Socratic Engine correctly implements the teaching philosophy - never giving the answer first, asking what the student was thinking, and guiding them with progressive hints until they discover the answer themselves.

minor.issue: Minor text duplication - 'the the f-file' appears in directional hints due to template formatting

action_items: Optional: Fix minor text duplication in HINT_TEMPLATES directional level - template has 'the {file_or_rank}' but file_or_rank already includes 'the' prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Socratic Engine API is fully tested and working. All endpoints validated: start (creates dialogue with opening question), respond (processes student response, celebrates discovery), hint (progressive hints from subtle to almost_answer), reveal (teaching explanation), and debug/test-socratic (demo flow). One minor cosmetic issue: directional hints have 'the the' duplication. Tests cover: happy paths, error handling (missing required fields), different position types (blunder, strategic, endgame, missed_tactic), full dialogue flows, and celebration when student discovers answer.

backend: POST /api/coach/socratic/start - Creates dialogue with opening question (never reveals answer)
POST /api/coach/socratic/respond - Processes student response, celebrates discovery or redirects
POST /api/coach/socratic/hint - Progressive hints (subtle, directional, specific, almost_answer)
POST /api/coach/socratic/reveal - Teaching explanation after student engagement
POST /api/coach/debug/test-socratic - Demo endpoint showing full dialogue flow
